insight: Partnered with Google DeepMind to bring Gemini Robotics to Apollo; a Feb 2026 extension grew its Series A alone past $935M.
name: Apptronik
tagline: Apollo, a general-purpose humanoid robot for logistics and manufacturing.
description: Austin-based Apptronik builds Apollo, a 5'8", 160 lb general-purpose humanoid robot with a 55 lb payload and swappable four-hour battery packs, designed to work in spaces built for humans. Apollo is being piloted in factories and warehouses with Mercedes-Benz and GXO Logistics under a robot-as-a-service model, and a strategic partnership with Google DeepMind pairs the hardware with Gemini Robotics models.
edge: Targets industrial deployment now — real Mercedes-Benz and GXO pilots and a DeepMind model partnership, while many humanoid rivals are still demo-stage.
cons: Enterprise RaaS only — no consumer product

references.title: Apptronik raises $520M Series A extension for humanoid robot Apollo
